999008199.text: くっ……！　こんないいところで！

localizations.en: Tch...! Not at a crucial moment like this!

999008199.text:
でも、このままだと岸にぷにたちが流れつくわ。
放っておくわけには……

localizations.en: But if we leave it like this, the punis will wash up on shore. We can't just ignore them...

999008199.text: 余った道具もない……もう駄目だよ、おしまいだよ！

localizations.en: We don't have any spare equipment... It's hopeless, we're finished!

999008199.text: これ……クリセルダからもらった水鉄砲……

localizations.en: This... the water gun Criselda gave me...

999008199.text:
おい、なんだか知らねぇけどよ
こいつに賭けるしかねぇんじゃねーか！？

localizations.en: Hey, I don't know what that thing is, but we gotta bet everything on it, right?!

999008199.text:
本当に危ないとき、一度だけ使う……
使うなら、今！！

localizations.en: Only use it once when things get really dangerous... If I'm going to use it, it's now!!

999008199.text: ら、ララ様、今のは一体！？

localizations.en: Q-Queen Lara, what was that just now?!

999008199.text: わ、わたくしにも分かりかねますわ……

localizations.en: I-I'm afraid I don't understand it myself...

999008199.text:
すさまじく苛烈で……
でも、美しい光でした……

localizations.en: It was tremendously intense... but such a beautiful light...

999008199.text: こんな強い水鉄砲、クリセルダはどうやって……

localizations.en: How did Criselda make such a powerful water gun...?

999008199.text: ソレヨリ　マダプニガ　ノコッテルワヨ！

localizations.en: More Importantly, There Are Still Punis Left!

999008199.text: あっ……！
この手は使いたくなかったけど……！

localizations.en: I didn't want to use this method, but...!

999008199.text: これで……一気に片付ける！

localizations.en: With this... I'll finish them all at once!

999008199.text: いっけえええ！！！

またまた何が起きたんだー！？
大きな爆発がぷにたちを包んだー！

localizations.en: What happened this time?! A huge explosion engulfed all the punis!

999008199.text:
でも、これでぷにはいなくなったみたいです。
レースの行方は……！

localizations.en: But it looks like the punis are gone now. As for the race...!

999008199.text: 水飛沫で何も見えませんが……！

localizations.en: The water spray is blocking our view...!

999008199.text:
最初にゴールしたのはアンチュ選手！
予選１位通過はアンチュ選手です！

localizations.en: The first to cross the finish line is Antje! Antje advances as the qualifier winner!

999008199.text:
ヨハナ選手はどうやら使っていた機体を失い、
速度を落としたようですね

localizations.en: It seems Johanna lost the machine she was using and had to slow down.

999008199.text:
……よかったの？　あんな事したら、
負けるのは確実だった

localizations.en: ...Was that really okay? If you did something like that, you were sure to lose.

999008199.text:
良くないに決まってるじゃない！
でも……

localizations.en: Of course it's not okay! But...

999008199.text: きっとレスナならそうしたわ

localizations.en: I'm sure that's what Resna would have done.

999008199.text: ……そうね
